bio: If you're not careful, you might end up walking right past the narrow façade of this mid-terrace restaurant. Here, an intriguing modern dining experience is proposed – and that goes for both the minimalist interior and the seasonally inspired cuisine, which is creative yet pleasingly accessible. Available either à la carte or as a surprise menu comprising four or six courses, the dishes are well-thought-out, with harmoniously balanced flavours. The staff are more than happy to cater to special dietary needs – please mention these when making your reservation. In addition to the wine pairings, the non-alcoholic alternatives are also highly recommended. From some tables it is possible to see into the kitchen. In summer, there is a terrace on the pavement overlooking the tram line....
